nodes.description: Makes HTTP requests to external APIs and web services.

error_patterns.title: Rate Limit Exceeded
error_patterns.explanation: The external API is rejecting requests due to rate limiting.
error_patterns.fix_steps:
- Add a Wait node to slow down requests
- Check the API's rate limit documentation

error_patterns.title: Authentication Failed
error_patterns.explanation: API credentials are invalid or expired.
error_patterns.fix_steps:
- Verify your API credentials
- Check if the key has expired
